name: At what stage of a basement remodel should trim and molding be installed?

mainEntity.name: At what stage of a basement remodel should trim and molding be installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basement trim usually goes in after the flooring and finished drywall are completely installed, but before the final paint touch-ups. Installing the baseboards over the finished flooring allows carpenters to hide uneven expansion gaps around vinyl plank, tile, or carpet edges. Door casings and window wraps can be set right after drywall and doors are hung. Pre-painting or priming the trim boards before fastening them to framing saves significant cleanup, requiring only nail hole patching, caulking, and a quick topcoat once installed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim is typically installed after drywall finishing and floor laying are done so baseboards can neatly cover flooring expansion gaps before final paint touch-ups.
